reviews.text:
Bought a new X6 40I for my wife and wanted to make sure the car was protected before it got nicked.  Researched some different shops for PPF and ceramic coatings and couldn’t be happier with my choice of Alpha Auto Works!

I had a number of phone conversations with Julie about their processes, materials, timetable, and workmanship over a few days and was quite impressed, but being a Virgo and skeptic I actually drove over to their shop to see the operation first hand.  I had the pleasure of meeting the owner and observing the staff working on various high end vehicles (G wagon, etc).  The owner took time from his work to show me the operation and explained in detail the work  and workmanship I could expect should I select them for the work.  I was quite comfortable after all of this  to say the least and elected to use their services.

I can’t say enough good things about this experience.  No games, no surprises.  Everything went just as planned including the trailering of the vehicle to and from their shop!  Shout out to AReal Trans Towing!  (They even facilitated a call with the towing company who called in advance to confirm details and allay any concerns I had-seriously it was first class!)

Bottom line the car came out great and I couldn’t be happier!  I’m a high maintenance customer and not once did I ever feel like I was imposing on them or being a nuisance.

Great workmanship, great experience and great results!

We didnt do any window tinting but If you’re in the market for PPF and or ceramic coating you won’t be disappointed using Alpha Auto Works!
reviews.author: Greg

reviews.text: I had the pleasure of taking my 2025 Expedition to ALPHA AUTO for PPF & Ceramic Coating and I couldn’t be happier with the outcome. I must say I was extremely pleased with the Level of Service I received from start to finish. Communication and scheduling were done with ease. All the services were explained to me and I felt completely comfortable making a decision. Al and his team at Alpha Auto do great work. I will definitely be a repeat customer. Thank you Again!
reviews.author: Robert Swirsding

reviews.text: Got 5% tint done on my 2026 Lexus GX550 and the experience was amazing. Julie was the best, super friendly, very knowledgeable, and made the whole process easy. The service was fast, the quality is top tier, and everything was extremely clean and professional. The waiting area was comfortable and even had snacks. Pricing was great for the quality you get, 100% worth it. I’ll definitely be recommending this place to my friends and family.
reviews.author: Staison George

reviews.text:
Was referred to Ilya for PPF.. he is very knowledgeable in his craft and his team is phenomenal. The work is incredible.
They recommended the ceramic coating and ceramic window tint as well.. so glad I got that done as well. Full satin PPF with the ceramic ontop. Overall a great experience, highly recommend.
reviews.author: Halyna Mykhailiv

reviews.text:
I needed to get my vehicle buffed/polished, I had discoloration on the hood, had light scratches on the side of the vehicle 🫣 and I am so glad that I went to Alpha Auto Works to do it! They had a deal for the two stage polish and a ceramic coating - just what I needed!

I was away on a trip and my dad dropped off my SUV to them. When I came back home and saw the vehicle - I was blown away by the quality of their work! The hood looked like it was repainted (check out the pictures), the scratches on the side of the car are gone!! And the SUV looks brand new!

What I didn’t know is that they will also detail the inside 🤯 that was a surprise for me! I had this one stain on the back chair (I have small kids) that I tried to remove and couldn’t - now it’s gone!

I can’t say enough of good things about Ilya and his crew. Great Job Ilya, you have a great team there, you guys did amazing work for me, you did more than you promised, most definitely over delivered! THANK YOU! And will refer people to you guys! 🙏
reviews.author: Alex Ankudovich
